title: Mittag-Leffler property and bounded kernels for the systems of homomorphisms and isomorphisms of the quotients M over I^n M
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The statement collects four facts about the systems obtained by reducing Hom and Isom groups modulo powers of an ideal: the Mittag-Leffler property, a uniform bound on the kernels and cokernels of the comparison maps, and the identification of the limits with Hom and Isom between the completed modules (statement lines 29059-29078). The proof replaces the Hom groups by the cohomology of a two-term complex obtained by dualizing a presentation of M, imports the Artin-Rees constant to get the Mittag-Leffler property and the uniform bound, and then identifies the limit with the completion of Hom, which is where the completeness of the completions is used (proof lines 29081-29109). The final part transfers the result to isomorphisms by applying the homomorphism case twice and invoking Nakayama, so the four assertions are proved in one coherent argument. The counted span refers four times, three of them to labelled results of another chapter, all carried as navigation stubs; the complexes, the limits and the isomorphism argument are inside the span.
